Noctowl

Normal Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Noctowl is a Normal/Flying-type Owl Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 40.8 kg. It evolves from Hoothoot. Its highest base stat is HP (100), with a base stat total of 452.
